decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with its own webpage, it reflects a visible commitment and management is likely to give it more time, attributing any weak early demand to market ramp-up rather than failure.
The separate product page signals clear public backing, and a large established manufacturer would typically persist for at least another year after launch to justify its recent investment.

Although website commitment is weaker because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it is still very new and management is likely to continue it while blaming disappointing results on an early commercialization phase.
Its dedicated webpage indicates stronger visibility and commitment, so escalation of commitment makes a near-term withdrawal unlikely despite any initial underperformance.
Even with only limited website prominence, it appears to be a broader product line and the firm is likely to defend the launch for another year rather than quickly reverse course.

This niche product has less visible public commitment than the stand-alone offerings, but because it was launched only recently management would still be inclined to persist and interpret poor results as temporary.
